observations.name: Road No. 36 chain from the Madhapur-side mid-stretch to the Peddamma Gudi station area
observations.notes: Forward-connected January 2025 Street View sequence follows Road No. 36 from the earlier Madhapur-side sample through the Peddamma-side station-marker area. The scenes show the elevated Metro deck and numbered piers, station stair/access structures, raised planted median and breaks, paver/asphalt transitions, commercial frontage, pedestrian movement, curbside loading/parking, cars, many motorcycles/scooters, auto-rickshaws, school/service vehicles, and a police-barricaded junction. A few cross-frame white markings may be traffic-calming markings, but their raised profile is not verified. Signs such as GOWRI on median/advertising boards are not storefront proof. The sequence is visual route continuity only: no surveyed road centerline/width, measured frontage bounds, complete side inventory, station gate, or exact neighbor order is established. One Dec 2021 comparison pano is excluded from this Jan 2025 context observation.

observations.name: Major Road No. 36 junction with temporary traffic police barricades
observations.notes: The connected Jan 2025 views show a busy junction, traffic police sign/barricades, turning and crossing traffic, and AUKERA frontage nearby. These frames do not prove the permanent signal layout, signal timing, or traffic-flow rules; no fixed signal is confidently visible in these specific angles.

observations.name: Peddamma-side Road No. 36 under the elevated Metro
observations.notes: The connected scenes reach the provisional Peddamma Gudi station-marker coordinate and show the elevated Metro viaduct, station stair structure, numbered piers, a planted raised median, Metro anti-billposting text, a mix of cars, scooters, motorcycles and auto-rickshaws, curbside parking, and dense retail signs across the corridor. This does not identify the station gate or prove station entry access. The marker/panorama is not a storefront or station entrance.
